🚨🇲🇽 <u>Senate Closes the Door: Only Mexicans Can Run Mexico</u>

Mexico's Senate approved the single-nationality reform 86 to 42. Anyone running for president, a governorship or Mexico City's top job must be Mexican by birth and hold no other citizenship. Articles 82, 116 and 122 of the Constitution change. Morena, PT and PVEM voted yes; PAN, PRI and MC voted no. It now goes to the state congresses. This comes one day after a Republican operative asked the Senate to kill it.

🇲🇽🔍 "The Barandilla's main judge left for the United States. We are requesting his extradition." — Presidenta Claudia Sheinbaum, Mañanera, Sept 29, 2026 New lines in the case of the 43 disappeared Ayotzinapa students come from reanalyzed phone calls of Sept 26–27, 2014, linking suspects to a funeral home that also held Iguala's morgue concession, and to a doctor. A raid found blank signed death certificates, a clandestine crematorium and hundreds of bone fragments, none matched to the students so far. The family and the doctor are detained. One student's phone turned up at the Barandilla court. Sheinbaum said journalist Anabel Hernández was used as a witness in the US to claim the students were never held there.

text: 🇲🇽✊ "It was a huge abandonment that caused tremendous pressure on the health institutions. Now what we are doing is reversing 36 years and moving forward." — Presidenta Claudia Sheinbaum, Mañanera, Sept 29, 2026 IMSS built 29,500 hospital beds in its first 40 years (1943–1982) and only 4,300 in the 36 neoliberal years (1983–2018), while the population and chronic disease kept growing. More than 10,000 new beds are now underway toward 2030. In two years, 33 new hospitals have opened across IMSS, ISSSTE and IMSS-Bienestar, and specialist consultations are up 36% over 2024.

🇲🇽🌎 "Mexico does not specialize in the production of weapons, because it's a pacifist decision that was made a long time ago." — Presidenta Claudia Sheinbaum, Mañanera, Sept 29, 2026 Asked about last week's visit by South Korea's president, Sheinbaum said Asian countries have been hit hard by the Iran war as oil and gas importers facing higher prices and scarcity. For Korea the defense industry is central; "for us, Mexico has historically decided that the defense industry is not the best path to development." The two governments agreed on a K-pop culture center in Mexico and, in reciprocity, an institute of Mexican culture in Korea.

🇲🇽✊ "Our hypothesis, and we'll hold it until someone proves otherwise, of why they didn't build: why invest in what you intend to privatize?" — Zoé Robledo, IMSS Director General, Mañanera, Sept 29, 2026 IMSS enrollment has grown fast: 22.76 million formal workers (+13%), 5.9 million covered parents (+35% since 2018) and 6.3 million pensioners (+46%). "The demographics and the burden of chronic disease were no surprise 20 years ago," Robledo said, describing a drift toward subcontracted services and "a mixed public-private model that ends up 100% private."

🇲🇽⚖️ "Don't lie, don't steal, and don't betray the people." — Presidenta Claudia Sheinbaum, Mañanera, Sept 29, 2026 Sheinbaum's advice to the coordinators Morena just chose by poll to organize the Fourth Transformation's work, repeating the movement's founding principles. She said the process showed a lot of unity, and those who did not win can still compete for mayoral races and state and federal congressional seats.

🔥🇲🇽 "I have no idea why they called it the 'anti-meme law.' I don't know where they got that, because it's an absolute lie. There isn't a single article that has to do with that." — Presidenta Claudia Sheinbaum, Mañanera, Sept 29, 2026 The newly approved intellectual property law targets piracy and speeds up patents. It bars private parties from selling government symbols, such as the national coat of arms or a state's shield, for profit. Flags sold on September 15 are not affected. "It has nothing to do with someone putting a symbol on social media, or banning memes."
